nodes.t: Prime-time interview. Both of you. Tonight, 8 PM. One hour before his video. We go first, we go big.
You love each other. You fell for each other at a charity match. Rehearse it.

nodes.n: Studio 3. Hot lights, a fake living room, and an anchor who has made three ministers cry.
"Captain. How did you know she was the one?"

choice.t: Tell the made-up charity match story.
Tell the truth about the parathas at 2 AM.
"She laughed at a pigeon story. Nobody laughs at my pigeon story."

nodes.n: Tara stops smiling for the camera. She's looking at you instead. The anchor notices. Everyone notices.

nodes.t: ...He makes parathas at midnight. He talks to my cat. He reads the whole contract before he signs anything. Of course it's real.

nodes.th: Contract. She said contract. On live TV.

nodes.n: Nobody catches it. Except Nikhil, who has gone pale.
9 PM. Vivaan's Part One goes live. A photo of a document. The first page of a contract. Names blacked out. "Clause seven: no falling in love."
The internet splits in half. #FakeShaadi trends against #ParathaLove.

nodes.t: He had the first page. Only my mother and Nikhil have that page.

nodes.cliff: Someone close to Tara sold the contract to Vivaan. Her mother? Or the man who wrote it?
